heading_2: Wireless Sensor Project (WiSP) at Potomac Photonics
body_1: A collaboration between Potomac Photonics, Potomac Mesosystems and Gray Technologies to create a network of wireless sensor nodes that communicate with mobile devices.
heading_4: Laser micromachining: ramp-up of complex semiconductor part
body_3: A Fortune 500 contract manufacturer needed a process for very high aspect ratio channels in a copper substrate, used for chip cooling in high-end computers.
heading_6: Strain gauge circuit to be embedded in fibreglass
body_5: An airframe research group needed miniature, single-layer electronic circuits that could be embedded in a fibreglass structure without mechanical perturbation.
heading_8: Prototyping at the speed of light
body_7: A start-up medical device company wanted to shorten prototyping lead times of 6+ weeks caused by fabricating new masks for each design change.
body_9: An electronics company needed a 1-week turnaround on 21 designs with multiple microhole diameters, as small as 10 microns, in two materials.
